settings.title: scope
settings.body: A site visit with your industries or education team: workshop space (Lowdham runs in 2,000 sq ft), security and tool-control requirements, cohort size agreed for your regime.

settings.title: set up
settings.body: Jigs, tooling and materials installed — a one-time setup, typically £7–10k depending on your workshop.

settings.title: train your team
settings.body: We train your instructors and workshop staff to deliver the course themselves — at HMP Lowdham Grange three Makers have been trained as peer instructors. The capability stays in-house, with no ongoing fees.

settings.title: deliver & accredit
settings.body: Repeatable six-week cohorts, budgeted around £8,500 each including materials and OCN Level 2 accreditation.

settings.title: family visit day
settings.body: Each cohort ends with Makers presenting the balance bikes they built to their own children — the bike goes home.

settings.title: per kit
settings.body: One balance-bike kit — the build each Maker completes and gives away.

settings.model_lede: Nationally, just 20% of prison-leavers are in work six weeks after release, and the proven reoffending rate is almost 30% (MoJ, 2024–25). Practical, accredited skills change those odds. Built for prison industries and education teams: we install the workshop, train your staff to deliver the course, and support your first cohorts — then the capability stays in-house.
settings.budget_lede: Reoffending costs the public purse £40,000+ per person per year (MoJ). Against that, the numbers below are small — and cohorts at existing sites have been grant-funded in full or in part. We'll help you make the case.
settings.stories_lede: Independent coverage and our own delivery records from the sites now running.
